svg.title: replayr universal button layout
svg.desc: A composite controller and peripheral diagrams map every registered control to its stable numeric ID, including both eight-direction stick sets and L3 and R3 clicks. The Wii Remote shows shared IDs for every recorded button. Keyboard and touchscreen examples retain source identities and numeric channels. Stable IDs differ from compact recording column numbers.
svg.text: Numbers are stable IDs from button_layout(). Labels identify the controls.
Direction IDs are added by cardinal4 or cardinal8. Angles and magnitudes appear in stick_channels().
Equal digits share IDs with Power Pad
Buttons 5–8 → L1, R1, L2, R2. Run and a handheld's Pause → Start.
Equivalent buttons share an ID. Keyboard keys retain their source key codes.
Key codes shown for unshifted letters.
Compact columns: in sample.dtm, column 6 is ID 7 (B); column 12 is ID 18 (Z). Inspect button_layout(movie).
